research_question: Does attention LoRA or native output-layer adaptation improve planning more efficiently, with direct object GT supervision deferred?
profile_selection: Among successfully completed finite five-update profiles below memory limits, choose lowest mean duration of updates 3–5. No development performance enters selection.
profile_failure_policy: Only a documented allocator/allocated-memory guard failure permits trying the other batch. Causal, nonfinite, source and other execution failures block the queue.
limitations: LoRA targets internal attention while partial tuning targets native output layers: method-level comparison, not isolated low-rank parameterization
Evaluation uses previously exposed small development panels
batch_upsize_admission: Before launching larger batch, extrapolate successful smaller-batch peak linearly by batch ratio plus 1GiB workspace margin; skip if it exceeds the registered allocated cap. Runtime guards still apply.
